name: Advaita Chandra
photoAlt: Placeholder illustration standing in for a profile photograph.
bio: I am Advaita. I am a student in India interested in philosophy, Indian politics, technology, and data. I am not an expert. This site contains my notes and projects as I work through questions.
learningDirection: Right now I am working on two things. First, handling sources that disagree with each other. Second, building my own tools. The data projects come from the first, and this website comes from the second.

approach.title: Narrow the question
approach.detail: Most work happens before research starts. I try to narrow questions until they are specific enough to be answered cleanly.

approach.title: Examine evidence
approach.detail: I check where figures originate. When sources disagree, I note the difference instead of picking the easiest number.

approach.title: Keep context
approach.detail: Definitions, time periods, and counting methods change what numbers mean. They need to stay attached to the data.

approach.title: Explain clearly
approach.detail: If I cannot explain something plainly, I do not understand it well enough yet.

epistemicNote: On this site I try to separate four things: facts from sources, my inferences, my opinions, and things I do not know.
